name: AKB48のWOW!!! ～THE WALK OF THE WORLD～
overview: A training location show for the AKB48 Kenkyuusei (students) to develop their variety skills while challenging location shoots and food reviews! The name of the program "WOW" is an abbreviation of "THE WALK OF THE WORLD," and the title represents the Kenkyuusei's wish to "become idols that will fly out into the world in the future."
